title: Understanding the Population
text: Think about who Aditi and Zekai are interested in studying. They want to know about chocolate milk preferences, but only for a specific group of students. What characteristic defines this group?

hintAnswer: All UC Berkeley students that spend an $$above-average$$ amount on chocolate milk.
title: Identifying the Group
text: Which of the following best describes the group Aditi and Zekai are interested in?
choices: All UC Berkeley students that spend an $$above-average$$ amount on chocolate milk.
All Data $$100$$ students that attend discussion section this week.
All chocolate milk manufacturers in Berkeley.
All UC Berkeley students who drink chocolate milk.
